motivation.policy: Retain both conditions only if qualified motivation or exact Phase H5 diagnostic evidence supports each. Conditional pilots limited to at most two conditions. Run Static10 and existing Idle10 first at the chosen cap, using Independent Starts and same workload.

observer.roi: Fixed central p20–p80 of scheduled arrivals; collector coverage is required for all three workers.
observer.armed_before_arrivals_control: A new full capture at Free QPS5 arms CUPTI before the measured cohort, samples scheduler state every 750ms rather than 500ms, and flushes only after drain. The previous short-ROI attempt had a 44.37% profile deviation at TTFT p50. This control removes collector initialization and CUDA synchronization from active requests.
observer.qualification: Preserve all attempts, including failed qualifications. Clean spread and profile deviation must each stay within 5% on all five metrics and collectors must pass. The 160ms D quiet gate is unchanged.

conditions: Free QPS5, five spare-GPU burners running
pilot.Free: Three diagnostic Main100 traces satisfy every other motivation check. Clean Decode SLO was 95–99%. The sustained trace supports P pressure and overlap but missed the 95% Decode SLO.
pilot.B4: Diagnostic P Busy 93.9%, B4's 160ms quiet coverage 25.1%, isolated D 9.703 req/s, with 95% clean screen and 97%/96% clean brackets. The profiled run's Decode SLO was 94%. The H5 clean SLO criterion uses separate unprofiled cohorts.
pilot.limits: Static10 correctness first for each cap. Run exactly two pilot conditions. No ratio optimization or Final GO without qualified motivation and independent performance confirmation.
